Jibowu underneath the bridge inward and outward Empire is okay for now.
Yaba bridge linking Tejuosho is moving steadily, likewise the return journey.
The stretch of Muritala Mohammed Way from Yaba to Oyingbo is perfect.
Oyingbo inward Iddo enroute Otto is good to go, likewise the return journey.
Oyingbo inward Ile ile is busy due to the market activities.
